title: Send feedback on the phone
question: The page should stay small with the keyboard up. Which layout? (4 of 4; each drops the big header for the usual top bar)

options.label: A slim bar over the keyboard
options.thesis: Pictures as a small row of thumbnails with a + tile, the field, and one slim bar: What's sent with it at the left, Send at the right.
options.viewport: Thumbnails and + at the top, Tell us about it under them, the bar sitting on the keyboard.
options.risk: The bar still moves with the keyboard, as today's does.

options.label: Send at the end of the page
options.thesis: No bar at all: the field first, the pictures row, then What's sent with it and Send at the bottom right of the form, scrolling with the page.
materials: Save bottom right, in the page
options.viewport: Tell us about it first, pictures under it, Send right below; nothing pinned to the keyboard.
options.risk: With a very long message, Send scrolls below the keyboard until you scroll.

options.label: Like writing a message
options.thesis: A message box docked on the keyboard: paperclip, the text, a round Send; chosen pictures as a strip above it.
options.viewport: A short lead at the top, the composer and its picture strip on the keyboard.
options.risk: A new pattern that no other form in the app uses.
